summary.en: A lit pair of chips slides together and closes into one learned chip; every row fuses the same pair, the token bar shrinks.
summary.zh: 一对亮起的字块滑到一起，合成一个“学到的”字块；每一行同时合并同一对，下面的词元条随之缩短。

fits: Any process whose step joins two neighbours into one unit: merging, compressing, bundling; the run decides which pair.
notFor: Reassignment or routing (items move from owner to owner and nothing fuses): fusing chips would say the wrong thing.

intent.en: Two neighbours visibly become one unit, so the viewer sees what a merge step does rather than being told.
intent.zh: 两个相邻单元看得见地合成一个，观众看到合并这一步做了什么，而不是听人说。

content.en: A board of rows of chips (a run: corpus of 2–6 words with weights); which pair fuses comes from the run.
content.zh: 一块由芯片行组成的板（一次运行：2–6 个带权重的词）；哪一对合并由运行决定。

fits.zh: 任何把两个相邻单元合成一个的过程：合并、压缩、打包；由运行决定合哪一对。

notFor.zh: 重新分配或路由（东西换主人、没有合并）：芯片融合会讲错。

pairs.note: the scene that names the rule

en: Every row must fuse the same pair in the same step; a row skipped reads as a bug.
zh: 每一行在同一步都要合并同一对；漏一行就像 bug。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
